Maya: Found the golden paperclip under the whiteboard bench. :eyes:
Ronen: No way. That's been missing since the Great Clip Migration of '22.
Liz: We need a ceremony. Lunch table, noon?
Maya: Proposal: whoever refactors the most controversial legacy file this week gets custody for 24hrs. :scroll:
ops-bot: Reminder: office keys should not be attached to non-official artifacts. Policy 3.4.1. :rotating_light:
Sam (design): I can design a tiny plaque. Sticker or metal? :art:
Ronen: Metal. It's historic.
Liz: Poll time — "Clip of Commitment" (:one:) or "Golden Binder" (:two:). React.
Maya: :one:
Tasha: found it while following a trail of post-its. shepherd duties accepted. :sheep:
Liz: Filing ticket artifact-1: "Golden Paperclip Plaque" and assigning to @Sam (design). Deadline: next all-hands.
Sam (design): on it. Also making a tiny ceremonial box. :package:
Maya: Ritual draft saved to #lore. Will bring a velvet pouch. See you at noon. :tea:
